services.name: ATV Rentals
services.desc: The Breaks now owns an ATV-friendly campground and cabins at Southern Gap. Since many of the roads on the Breaks side of the park are not open to ATV traffic, including those leading to the cabins and the campground, we strongly recommend that guests with ATV’s consider staying at our Southern Gap campground and cabins! ATVs may use the front gate and main road to travel to the lodge and visitor center, continuing up to Catawba Lodge. However, they are not permitted beyond the yellow gate at Catawba. Whether you prefer a leisurely paddle to take in the scenic views or wish to try your hand at fishing from our rental crafts, the choice is yours.
